title: Walk2Brdway~Queen Bunkbed~King Bed~Fast Wifi~Pool
description:
Come experience Nashville in this Honky Tonk retreat! Nestled in the heart of Music City and just a quick walk from Broadway, this space offers 5-star amenities including a cozy king bed, luxe queen high bunk beds, a fully stocked coffee bar, themed lighting, and a balcony oasis. Enjoy the dual-sink master bath and floor-length mirrors—perfect for all the fit checks! You don’t want to miss this one. Can you hear it? Music City is calling!

The space
We took the highlights of Nashville and brought them all into one place just for you! Get in the mood to visit your bucket list muesum and honky tonk or kick off your boots and unwind after a night out!

We are located:

    • 0.3 miles from Country Music Hall of Fame
    • 0.4 miles from Bridgestone Arena
    • 0.6 miles from Ryman Auditorium
    • 0.6 miles from Tootsies
    • 0.6 miles from Morgan Wallen’s
    • 0.7 miles from Kid Rock’s
    • 0.7 miles from Johnny Cash Museum
    • 0.8 miles from the Gulch
    • 1.1 miles from Nissan Stadium
    • And so much more!

Key Amenities:

    • Cozy king master bedroom
    • Luxurious queen high bunk beds
    • High end linens, bedding, and pillows
    • Full size washer and dryer with complimentary detergent and fabric softener
    • Fully stocked coffee bar, including variety of tea and hot chocolate
    • Mixology set
    • Handheld steamer, iron and ironing board
    • Complimentary parking for one vehicle 
    • Free high speed internet

STR Permit #2022059305

Guest access
During your stay you will have access to the entire condo. You will also have access to all of the shared amenities of the building.

This includes:
    • Saltwater Pool
    • Cycle Room
    • Fitness Center
    • Sky Deck (Including mini fridge, Large TV's, Pool Table and Fireplace)
    • Outdoor Lounge Area (Including Grill, Fire Pit, and Mini Fridge)

Other things to note
Check in instructions will be sent no less than 24 hours prior to check in. Early check in and late check out available upon request and availability. Please reach out with any questions and we cannot wait to have you enjoy our Honky Tonk Retreat!
